titulo: Wisconsin police investigating fraternity for hazing after men found in basement
cuerpo: Pledges found covered in food in heated basement of fraternity house near University of Wisconsin-Madison Police are investigating suspected illegal hazing after about 30 partially clothed young men covered in food, condiments and other liquids were found recently in the basement of a fraternity house near the University of Wisconsin -Madison campus. Madison police said some of the men, whom they described as pledges of a fraternity, had signs of being physically assaulted. Continue reading...
